name: Payroll Notes
query:
SELECT *
FROM (

    SELECT
        'Loan' AS `Type`,
        lr.name AS `Reference`,
        lr.employee AS `Employee`,
        lr.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        lr.company AS `Company`,
        rs.payment_date AS `Date`,
        rs.total_payment AS `Amount`,
        'Loan' AS `Component`,
        NULL AS `Remarks`
    FROM `tabLoan Request` lr
    JOIN `tabLoan Request Repayment Schedule` rs
        ON rs.parent = lr.name
    WHERE
        lr.docstatus = 1
        AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR lr.company = %(company)s)
        AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR rs.payment_date >= %(from_date)s)
        AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR rs.payment_date <= %(to_date)s)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Additional Salary' AS `Type`,
        a.name AS `Reference`,
        a.employee AS `Employee`,
        e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        a.company AS `Company`,
        a.payroll_date AS `Date`,
        a.amount AS `Amount`,
        a.salary_component AS `Component`,
        a.remarks AS `Remarks`
    FROM `tabAdditional Salary` a
    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e
        ON e.name = a.employee
    WHERE
        a.docstatus = 1
        AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR a.company = %(company)s)
        AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR a.payroll_date >= %(from_date)s)
        AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR a.payroll_date <= %(to_date)s)

) AS combined

ORDER BY `Date` DESC;
